Job Description
The Vice President, APAC (SG, AU, NZ, JP, TH, MY, KR, IN) Customer Service Organization is the leader for a strategically critical, highly visible, and rapidly growing region of Agilent Technologies. The Customer Service Organization is responsible for running and growing a large and complex field service business with a strong mix of both transactional and strategic customers.
You will have accountability for driving a high-performance culture that delivers on Agilent’s strategic objectives. This is accomplished by building loyalty with our customers, shareholders, and employees while developing organizational capabilities to meet future business challenges.
The role includes providing leadership and management oversight across all aspects of our field service business, including employees, systems, and processes, as well as the ability to execute strategy with rigor and discipline. The successful candidate will have extensive service business leadership experience and possess strong knowledge of Agilent’s Instruments, Software, and Services portfolio, along with a deep understanding of customers and markets across the APAC region.
You will demonstrate strong strategic and operational leadership capabilities, coupled with the ability to communicate effectively and collaborate cross-functionally at the executive level.
The APAC CSO Vice President will provide direction and consultation to both the direct and extended APAC CSO leadership team, helping to define execution strategies, optimize organizational resources, and harmonize processes across the region.
You will partner closely with Global CSO executive staff members and key stakeholders across the Commercial Organization to define and execute the APAC strategic field deployment strategy, ensuring alignment of priorities, consistent execution, operational excellence, and customer-centric outcomes across diverse markets.

Bachelor's or Master's Degree or equivalent.
10+ years of Customer Service Operations Management or comparable regional leadership experience.
Demonstrated P&L leadership experience with accountability for revenue growth, profitability, forecasting, and resource allocation.
Growth mindset with a proven ability to identify new opportunities, drive innovation, and deliver sustainable business growth.
Proven ability to drive profitable growth through strong commercial acumen and customer-centric business leadership.
Experience leading large, geographically dispersed organizations across multiple countries and cultures.
Team building and cross-functional leadership skills with a proven track record of collaboration across regions and functions.
Natural and authentic leadership with strong people development, coaching, and performance management capabilities.
Ability to shape and execute strategic direction while driving organizational alignment and accountability.
Experience leading business transformation, digital enablement, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Exceptional business acumen with the ability to translate financial and operational insights into business results.
Ability to influence and align senior stakeholders across the Commercial Organization, Business Units, and corporate functions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; fluent in English.
Strategic thinker with strong execution discipline and a results-oriented mindset.
Customer Experience advocate.
Experience operating in an international/global business environment

As a Program Support Specialist (District NxPert), GS-0301-9, your typical work assignments may include: Inspecting files on a periodic basis of the Regional Offices and the Agency's electronic case management system to ensure all records are stored and labeled correctly, the correct data has been recorded, and that they contain current material without duplication.

Serving as the case management system of records contact on all operational features. Providing support independently, both in-person and by telephone, to users of the electronic case management system, troubleshooting problems users encounter when working within the system.

Facilitating program analysis by assisting in the planning, organization and collection of and analysis of pertinent data relative in determining a variety of trends in system operations.

Using analytical techniques to diagnose problems that users may encounter while working with the electronic case management systems and resolving problems experienced with use of Teams, Zoom, LiveMeeting, and other videoconferencing tools.

Serving as an electronic case management trainer for the assigned Agency personnel by arranging and conducting training sessions, sometimes by video conference, on the use of the electronic case management system.
All qualifications and eligibility requirements must be met by the closing date of the announcement. IDEAL CANDIDATE STATEMENT The ideal candidate for the Program Support Specialist (District NxPert) position has significant experience working with case management systems and is familiar with case processing.

The candidate has excellent technical skills and is able to both use the case management system and teach others how to use it.

Strong oral and written communication skills are essential to prepare and conduct training, provide feedback, and interact with colleagues performing mission-related work, as well as support work related to information technology.

The candidate is able to work independently, manage projects at various stages and priorities, and demonstrate meticulous attention to detail.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Applicants must have one year of specialized experience, equivalent to the GS-07 grade level, which has provided them with the knowledge, skills, and abilities to successfully perform the duties of a Program Support Specialist (District NxPert) at the GS-09 grade level.

Specialized experience includes: Experience assessing the data integrity of the documents and data being uploaded into the electronic case management system; and Experience resolving issues and providing technical support when using an electronic case management system; and Experience training or assisting staff on the use of an electronic case management system within their area of responsibility.

OR EDUCATION: Master's or equivalent graduate degree or 2 full years of progressively higher-level graduate education leading to such a degree or LL.B. or J.D., if related (Note: You must submit a copy of your transcripts.).

OR COMBINATION OF EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: A combination of education and experience may be used to qualify for this position as long as the computed percentage of the requirements is at least 100 percent.

(Note: You must submit a copy of your transcripts.) This experience must be fully supported and articulated in your resume to receive consideration. Please do not cut and paste the specialized experience from this announcement into your resume, as this will not be considered a demonstration of your qualifications for this position.

TIME-IN-GRADE REQUIREMENTS All current Federal employees must meet time-in-grade requirements to be considered eligible. One year of experience at the GS-07 or equivalent grade level of federal service, is required to qualify for the GS-09 grade level.

(NOTE: All Agency employees must provide a copy of their SF-50 "Notice of Personnel Action" that indicates proof of status and time-in-grade eligibility. The SF-50 must include your position, title, series, grade, step, tenure (1 or 2), and type of service (Competitive). You may determine your current status by checking block 24 on your SF-50.

Block 24 must reflect "1" or "2". Also, block 34 must reflect "1". NOTE: Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

The Mission Support Specialist (Workforce Management) serves as a liaison between Mission Readiness Operations and various support offices to carry out projects, perform studies, and address technical issues or problems related to the workforce.

Duties and responsibilities include: Assisting managers and supervisors with administrative coordination related to disciplinary and adverse actions, grievances, and changes to working conditions; serving as a liaison with Human Resources and Labor-Employee Relations to support resolution of complex workforce issues; and assisting with implementation of policies related to workforce and position management.

Maintaining workforce reports and updating information for agency manning documents; coordinating with supervisors and staff to ensure timely completion of actions and receipt of required documentation; and submitting and monitoring personnel actions.

Serving as a liaison with support offices, including Labor-Employee Relations, EEO, workers' compensation staff, and counsel, on matters with workforce implications; and preparing reports using internal data sources and agency automated systems to support managerial information needs.

Performing general mission support activities, including coordinating travel and training, organizing logistical elements, analyzing non-overtime budget information, supporting procurement and acquisition actions, and serving as a point of contact for headquarters and/or sector office staff.
FOR: GS-09 Experience: You qualify for the GS-09 grade level if you possess one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level, performing duties such as: Supporting administrative projects related to workforce management, including project planning, execution, tracking, evaluation, and process improvement.

Researching, compiling, and analyzing data from multiple sources to support decision-making, identify trends, and provide recommendations to improve workforce operations.

Supporting workforce management functions, including staffing, personnel actions, time and attendance, benefits coordination, workforce documentation, or position management activities.

Maintaining and reviewing official workforce-related documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and compliance with applicable policies and procedures.

Coordinating with supervisors, managers, Human Resources, and other support offices to monitor personnel actions, resolve administrative issues, and support workforce-related projects.

OR Education Substitution: Successful completion of a master's degree, two full years of graduate education leading to such a degree, or a J.D. or LL.B may substitute for the experience required at this level. This education must demonstrate the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to do the work.

Check with your school to determine how many credit hours comprise a year of graduate education. If that information is not available, use 36 semester or 54 quarter hours.

FOR: GS-11 Experience GS-11: You qualify for the GS-11 grade level if you possess one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level, performing duties such as: Leading or coordinating multiple administrative projects related to workforce management, with accountability for project outcomes and ensuring all deliverables meet established standards.

Identifying, analyzing, and resolving a wide range of multifaceted problems relevant to workforce management and workers' compensation, utilizing advanced analytical methods. Conducting advanced data analysis from diverse sources to identify trends, patterns, and develop actionable recommendations for process improvement and compliance.

Preparing and presenting comprehensive reports, briefings, and correspondence for senior management or external stakeholders, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and relevance.

OR Education Substitution: A Ph.D. or an equivalent doctoral degree, three full years of progressively higher-level graduate education leading to such a degree or an LL.M. degree from an accredited college or university may substitute for experience required at this level.

This education must demonstrate the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to do the work. Check with your school to determine how many credit hours comprise three years of graduate study. If that information is not available, use 54 semester or 81 quarter hours.

NOTE: Your resume must explicitly indicate how you meet this requirement, otherwise you will be found ineligible. Please see the "Required Documents" section below for additional resume requirements.

Combining Education and Experience: Combinations of successfully completed post-high school education and experience may be used to meet total qualification requirements for the grade levels, and may be computed by first determining your total qualifying experience as a percentage of the experience required for the grade level; then determining the your education as a percentage of the education required for the grade level; and then adding the two percentages.

The total percentages must equal at least 100 percent to qualify for that grade level. Only graduate education in excess of the amount required for the next lower grade level may be used to qualify applicants for positions at grades GS-9 and GS-11. More information on this qualification standard is located here.

Mercury is evolving how we think about Quality — moving from a primarily scorecard-based model toward an insights-driven, coaching-focused approach that helps teams learn, improve, and scale responsibly.
We're looking for a Senior Quality Analyst to join us during this evolution. This role sits at the intersection of quality expertise, AI-assisted analysis, and cross-functional partnership—supporting compliance and integrity work while helping us leverage AI to better understand customer interactions at scale and translate those insights into meaningful improvements.
*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Drive quality consistency and operational integrity: Review customer interactions to assess compliance, risk, and quality standards, applying strong judgment in ambiguous or edge-case scenarios. Lead and contribute to calibration efforts that strengthen fairness, alignment, and consistency across quality evaluations.
Deliver behavior-based quality insights: Provide thoughtful, actionable feedback on customer interactions, identifying strengths, opportunities, and recurring behaviors that support coaching, skill development, and performance improvement.
Investigate patterns and uncover meaningful signals at scale: Leverage AI-assisted tools, QA data, and qualitative analysis to identify recurring behaviors, risks, and opportunity areas across large volumes of customer interactions, surfacing trends that would be difficult to identify through manual review alone.
Connect insights to root causes and operational improvements: Distinguish between agent behavior, process gaps, and product or tooling issues to identify root causes and translate findings into actionable recommendations for quality processes, workflows, and customer experience improvements.
Translate insights into coaching and cross-functional action: Synthesize patterns and signals into clear, actionable guidance for Leadership, Enablement, and cross-functional partners, helping drive follow-through and measurable improvements across support operations.
Contribute to the evolution of the Quality model: Support experimentation, iterative improvement, and new approaches to understanding customer interactions at scale as Mercury continues evolving toward a more insights-driven, AI-assisted Quality function.

2–4+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or a related Customer Experience role, ideally in a fast-paced, operationally complex, or regulated environment
Strong quality judgment and systems thinking: You can evaluate how work is done — not just outcomes — and identify patterns, root causes, and opportunities for improvement across people, processes, and tooling
Insight generation and problem-solving skills : You’re able to investigate open-ended questions using QA data, qualitative examples, and AI-assisted analysis, translating patterns into clear, actionable recommendations that support coaching and operational improvement
Cross-functional communication and influence: You build trust across teams, communicate insights clearly, surface risks and gaps proactively, and help stakeholders align on actions and move improvement efforts forward through strong follow-through and coordination
Ownership, adaptability, and continuous improvement mindset: You operate effectively in evolving environments, move ideas into action with minimal guidance, and proactively identify ways to improve systems, workflows, and quality practices over time
AI-assisted quality tooling experience: Experience using AI-assisted analysis tools (such as Rippit, Claude, or similar platforms) to investigate customer interactions, identify meaningful patterns, and support operational decision-making. Curiosity and experience refining prompts or queries to improve signal quality and reduce noise is highly valued.

About Wing
Wing Assistant is building the next generation of AI-enabled workforce solutions for growing businesses. We help companies get high-quality support across roles like executive assistance, admin support, customer support, sales support, recruiting support, operations support, and other business functions. Now we're standing up an always-on first line of customer support, and you'll build that team.

This is hands-on leadership, not a desk-and-dashboard job.

You set the standard by working the queue yourself, then hold the team to it through coaching, quality audits, and a clock everyone can see.You own two things above all: that customers always get a fast, high-quality first response, and that the round-robin model stays trusted, so our Customer Success Managers rely on it instead of routing around it.

You're the person who makes sure this system doesn't quietly decay back into "just message the CSM and hope.
Responbilities

Team & coverage

· Build the shift schedule and on-call rotation so someone is always covering, evenings and weekends included, with named backups

· Run standups: yesterday's SLA hits and misses, every escalation reviewed, anything that slipped off-queue

· Onboard and certify new reps, nobody touches the live queue until they pass a drill-based certification
Quality & consistency

· Own the weekly quality audit and coach against the results

· Enforce the non-negotiables: no ticket, no work; every reply ends with a next step, owner, and time; SLAs run from ticket creation; nothing is called "handled" until it's verified

· Protect trust between tiers, a bad handoff that burns a CSM is a same-day fix

· Spot and shut down shadow channels
Escalations

· Be the escalation point when a rep is unsure, and the backstop on the emergency path

· Keep the routing playbook and templates current as real issues teach you what's missing
Reporting

· Own the support dashboard and bring it to the weekly operations review

· Surface trends early, if cancellations or a particular issue are climbing, you often see it first

· 4+ years in customer support/service, including 1+ year leading or coaching a team

· Excellent written English and a high bar for how the team writes

· Real experience with SLAs, queues, and support metrics

· Fair, structured, consistent coach, you hold a standard without micromanaging

· Calm and decisive in escalations

· Comfortable owning a dashboard and presenting to leadership

· Reliable home internet, professional remote workspace, backup connectivity

· Experience standing up or restructuring a support function, not just running one

· Hands-on with HubSpot Service Hub, Freshdesk, Zendesk, or Intercom, including reporting

· Background in staffing, recruiting, virtual assistants, or BPO

· Experience running shift-based or 24/7 teams

Du kennst den Moment, wenn sich der Ansitz endlich lohnt? Genau dieses Gefühl begleiten wir digital.
Mit MyHunt / Jagdgefährte bauen wir die App, die Jäger:innen, Reviermanager:innen und Naturschützer:innen durch die gesamte Jagd begleitet – von der Planung über die Revierarbeit bis zur Dokumentation von Strecke, Wildbestand und Biodiversität. Hunderttausende Jäger:innen in Europa gehören zu unserer Community, und wir skalieren gerade international.
Damit sich unsere Nutzer:innen bei jedem Anliegen gut aufgehoben fühlen, suchen wir dich: als Werkstudent:in im Customer Support, 20 Stunden pro Woche, vor Ort in unserem Münchner Office.
Und damit das klar ist: Diese Rolle ist mehr als Tickets abarbeiten. Du bist die Stimme unserer Nutzer:innen im Team – was dir im Support auffällt, landet direkt bei Produkt und Entwicklung.
Aufgaben
Als Werkstudent:in im Customer Support bist du die erste Ansprechperson für unsere Community:
Du beantwortest Anfragen unserer Nutzer:innen per E-Mail, in den App-Stores und in unseren Community-Kanälen – freundlich, verständlich und auf Augenhöhe.
Du hilfst bei allem, was in der App hakt: von der Revierkarte über die Wildkamera-Anbindung bis zur Abo-Verwaltung.
Du reproduzierst gemeldete Fehler, dokumentierst sie sauber und gibst sie strukturiert an unsere Entwickler:innen weiter.
Du pflegst und erweiterst unsere Hilfe-Artikel und FAQs – damit häufige Fragen künftig gar nicht erst zum Ticket werden.
Du erkennst Muster: Welche Fragen kommen immer wieder? Wo verstehen Nutzer:innen ein Feature nicht? Dein Feedback fließt direkt in unsere Produktentwicklung ein.
Du unterstützt bei der Betreuung unserer Community und bei Nutzerbefragungen.
Qualifikation
Das erwarten wir von Dir
Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in (die Fachrichtung ist uns egal) und wohnst in oder um München – wir arbeiten gemeinsam im Office, weil Support im Team einfach besser funktioniert.
Du hast einen Bezug zur Jagd. Idealerweise hast du selbst den Jagdschein oder machst ihn gerade – denn wer weiß, wie ein Ansitz, eine Drückjagd oder die Streckenmeldung abläuft, versteht unsere Nutzer:innen sofort. Ehrliches, tiefes Interesse an Jagd und Naturschutz zählt aber genauso.
Du bist empathisch und geduldig. Auch wenn jemand frustriert schreibt, findest du den freundlichen, souveränen Ton – und die Lösung.
Du schreibst gut. Klar, korrekt und sympathisch, auf Deutsch (muttersprachliches Niveau) und Englisch (sicher in Wort und Schrift).
Du arbeitest eigenständig und verlässlich – wenn du eine Anfrage übernimmst, bleibst du dran, bis sie gelöst ist.
Du bist technikaffin genug, um dich in eine App einzuarbeiten und ein Problem präzise zu beschreiben. Programmieren musst du nicht können.
Ein Plus, aber kein Muss: weitere Sprachen (besonders Französisch, Spanisch, Italienisch), erste Erfahrung im Support oder Service, Erfahrung mit Tools wie Zendesk, Intercom oder Notion.

Ein Produkt, das du selbst nutzt. Du arbeitest an einer App, die du am Wochenende im Revier dabeihast.
Echter Einfluss: Deine Beobachtungen aus dem Support verändern das Produkt – kurze Wege zu Produkt, Design und Entwicklung, flache Hierarchien.
Flexible Zeiteinteilung , die zu deinem Stundenplan passt, inklusive Rücksicht auf Prüfungsphasen.
Ein Office, in dem man gerne ist: geteilt mit anderen Ventures, Dachterrasse mit BBQ, Kicker- und Billardturniere, Freigetränke und so viel guten Kaffee aus der Siebträger, wie du willst.
Ein junges, internationales Team mit Leidenschaft für Technologie und nachhaltige Jagd.
Perspektive: Bei uns sind schon mehrere Werkstudent:innen nach dem Studium fest eingestiegen.
Kein Motivationsschreiben nötig. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf – gerne kurz – und beantworte uns zwei Fragen direkt im Bewerbungsformular:
Ein:e Nutzer:in schreibt dir verärgert, dass die App seine bzw. ihre Streckenmeldung „verschluckt" hat und die Jagdsaison damit ruiniert sei. Wie antwortest du? (3–5 Sätze genügen.)
Was ist dein Bezug zur Jagd? (1–2 Sätze.
Wir melden uns innerhalb einer Woche bei dir.
Wenn es passt, laden wir dich zu einem lockeren Gespräch im Office, oder bei guten Wetter auch im Biergarten neben an ein ;)

At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces .
We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.
Ready to join us?

We’re looking for a Support Specialist to join our team, with a focus on data products. You'll be responsible for working directly with clients from various organizations, potentially including those who play in notable competitions such as the Spanish LaLiga, French Ligue 1, English Premier League and others. As a team, our goal is to understand our clients' pain points and help them make the most of our solutions.
Location
For this role, we're currently considering candidates who live within a commuting distance of our office in London/Barcelona, and are available to work from our office at least three days per week.
Must-Haves
Data fluent . Skilled in Python or R for coding, with strong SQL abilities for data cleaning and manipulation.
Client-focused communicator . Whether it is over video conferences or emails, you confidently engage with users, listen with empathy, and explain solutions clearly while keeping a human touch.
Problem solver . You approach challenges through the client’s perspective, troubleshoot technical issues efficiently, and take ownership in delivering reliable, game-changing support.
Team player . You thrive in dynamic environments, remain flexible with schedules and communication channels, and actively partner with product teams to advocate for customer needs and share insights.
Multilingual. You can speak English and at least one other European language fluently.
Nice-to-Haves
Certified. You hold education or certification in data analytics or big data in sport.
Sports analytics expert. You combine experience with machine learning and advanced statistical methods, hands-on work with sports datasets from providers like StatsBomb, and the ability to transform insights into clear visuals using tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
Video-savvy. You have hands-on experience with video analysis tools like Sportscode, Wyscout, Mediacoach, or similar platforms.
Experienced in tech support. As our users' first point of contact, it’s a plus if you’ve had a previous role where you answered calls and emails that ranged from how-to questions to technical troubleshooting.

Due to continued growth, internal promotions and an ongoing need to support our expanding customer base, we’re excited to be hiring Customer Service Advisors.
Operations in banking like in every other firm is established to carry out all the day-to-day transactions of the business. The Operations function within Allica has wide-ranging responsibilities supporting the customers of all product lines (Commercial Mortgages, Asset Finance, Deposits and Payment Account with aligned card activity), alongside our own internal stakeholders.

Slick digital account opening, and in life servicing.
Customer contact via telephony, email and in-app communications.

Support of all change initiatives.
Role Description
The Customer Service Advisor will be responsible for 1st line customer service support for the Bank’s Retail and SME customers via Chat (Online) and Telephony, together with Back Office activities to support the smooth running of the function.

Principal Accountabilities
To field inbound communications from customers – either over voice, chat or social media – to action their requests, resolve their issues and manage complaints through to resolution.

To proactively identify areas for process improvement and to seek new and innovative ways to better serve the customer.

Personal Attributes & Experience
Strong customer service experience, having worked in customer facing and or telephone service roles.

Experience in working with workflow / task management tools.

Beratung \& Betreuung mit Weitblick: Du begleitest Privat\- und Firmenkunden in allen Versicherungsfragen mit echtem Engagement und sicherst massgeschneiderte Lösungen für jedes individuelle Bedürfnis. Als Kundenberater:in bist du da, wenn es darauf ankommt.

Wachstum aktiv gestalten: Du hast ein gutes Netzwerk und bringst deine Energie in die Akquise neuer Kundinnen und Kunden ein. Dein Engagement sorgt dafür, dass unser Kundenstamm beständig wächst. Wie können wir dich hierbei unterstützen? Indem du einen eigenen Kundenstamm mit Privat\- und Firmenkunden erhältst.
Marketing\- \& Vertriebsunterstützung: Mit frischen Ideen unterstützt du unsere Marketingaktionen, besuchst Messen und Veranstaltungen, um unser Netzwerk zu stärken.
Immer am Puls der Zeit: Durch unsere Grundausbildung und kontinuierliche Weiterbildungen bleibst du fachlich auf dem neuesten Stand und bietest höchste Beratungskompetenz.
Was du mitbringst
Erfahrung \& Expertise: Du bringst Erfahrung in der Kundenberatung oder im Verkauf mit \- optimalerweise in der Finanz\- oder Versicherungsbranche. Auch ambitionierte Quereinsteiger:innen, die bereit sind durchzustarten sind herzlich willkommen.
Kommunikationstalent: Menschen begeistern und gewinnen \- das liegt dir im Blut. Du glänzt durch Kommunikations\- und Verhandlungsstärke. Du kannst als Kundenberater:in überzeugend argumentieren und verfügst über stilsichere Deutschkenntnisse.

Engagement \& Eigeninitiative: Mit überdurchschnittlicher Motivation und Unternehmergeist bist du bereit, Grosses zu erreichen und Ziele zu übertreffen.
Regionale Verankerung: Dein Wohnort liegt in der Region Zug, in der du deine Kundinnen und Kunden betreust. Du verfügst über ein starkes Netzwerk in der Region und schätzt es, neue Kontakte aufzubauen und zu pflegen.

Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com .
Bitwarden truly cares and wants all Bitwarden users to have the best experience while accessing their sensitive information. The Customer Success team helps customers and all users meaningfully engage with Bitwarden products while proactively planning for user growth, service availability, and to ultimately achieve their desired outcome.

Team members have excellent product knowledge, superb technical skills, stellar grammar, attention to detail, and the ability to explain complicated things simply.
Bitwarden seeks a server and cloud enthusiast, with experience in both communicating about and deploying these technologies. You will become a Bitwarden product expert and partner with the Customer Engagement Managers to help customers with their initial production deployments post-sales, as well as implement new features as they are released and increase their adoption of the Bitwarden platform.
This is an all-remote team and we're looking for someone located in the UK.

Participate in customer quarterly business reviews by assisting in environment audits, best-practices reviews, and positioning new product features relevant to further expansion opportunities and/or increased adoption
Collaborating with Engineering and Product associates to triage bug reports and feature requests based on customer need and scale with a focus on large Enterprise deployments
Assist training and culture sharing in the Implementation Engineering Team
Guide knowledge sharing among Implementation Engineers within the team and in collaboration with Technical Writing to share best-practices, troubleshooting information, and recommended configurations
Lead and/or assist in internal team projects including customer environment replication for bug investigations, integrations with new third-party tools, and development of automations both for customer use-cases as well as internal team processes
Occasionally represent Bitwarden at customer meetings, industry events, or team offsites (some travel may be required).

Time in Grade: For entry at the GS-12 level, status applicants must have served 52 weeks as a GS-11 or equivalent or higher grade, in the Federal Service Specialized Experience: Applicants must have 52 weeks of specialized experience at the GS-11 level or equivalent under another pay system.

Specialized experience is defined as performing in an investigative support role for a high-level professional or government program.

Experience includes compiling work that involves applying investigation and compliance principles, concepts, and methodologies; independently identify sources of information to detect illegal activity and document issues or probable cause; research, analyze, interpret, and evaluate data and information to make appropriate recommendations; preparing reports and technical information according to agency policy and procedures.

You must meet the minimum qualification requirements as stated in the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) Operating Manual, Qualification Standards for General Schedule Positions: http://www.opm.gov/qualifications/Standards/group-stds/gs-prof.asp.

Paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual, community, student, social) is qualifying.

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience. Qualification and time-in-grade requirements must be met by the closing date of this announcement.

Applicants who have held a non-temporary General Schedule (GS) position within the last 52 weeks must meet the time-in-grade restriction.

If you did not reach your full performance level or promotion potential, you should also submit an additional SF-50 that documents that grade level. For more details on ICTAP, see 5 CFR Part 330 Subpart G and OPM's Guide to Career Transition.

## Description ##
## Your Purpose ##
MSC Cruises is the world-s third-largest cruise brand as well as the leader in Europe, South America, the Gulf region, and Southern Africa with more market share in addition to deployed capacity than any other player. It is also the fastest-growing global cruise brand with a strong presence in the Caribbean, North America, and Far East markets.

Headquartered in Geneva, MSC Cruises is one of the two brands that sit within the Cruise Division of MSC Group, the leading privately held Swiss-based shipping and logistics conglomerate with over 300 years of maritime heritage.

MSC Cruises - the contemporary brand - has a modern fleet of 22 cruise ships with three new vessels due to be launched in 2025, 2026, and 2027.
In line with MSC Cruises service standard & procedures, the B2B Contact Centre Agent provides commercial advice (by telephone and other channels) to travel agents in order to finalize the sale of MSC Cruises products and services.

Handles travel agencies- telephone calls, in line with the Service Standards and Procedures;
Responds to travel agents- requests coming by telephone, email or fax;
Promotes MSC Cruises products and services;
Uses the reservation system to process telephone sales;
Assists travel agents with specialist support such as reservations changes, purchase of additional services and special requests.
## Your Journey so far ##
Experience dealing with clients either over the phone or face-to-face.
Sales experience (preferable).
Communication and interpersonal skills.
Sales and persuasion skills.
Proactivity and results orientation.
Problem-solving abilities.
## Your Essentials ##
Fluent in Italian and English; any additional European language (particularly French or German) is considered an advantage.
University degree in Economics, Business Administration, Marketing & Communication, or Linguistic Studies.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office.

Du möchtest einen technischen Kundendienst nicht nur administrativ begleiten, sondern ihn eigenständig verantworten? Du behältst Reparaturen, Reklamationen, Ersatzteile und laufende Servicefälle im Griff und bist für Kunden die verlässliche Ansprechperson, wenn eine schnelle und saubere Lösung gefragt ist.
Unsere Mandantin ist die Schweizer Tochtergesellschaft einer global tätigen Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Hydraulik, Antriebstechnik und kundenspezifische Systemlösungen. In dieser Funktion übernimmst du eigenständig die Verantwortung für den Aftersales und Kundendienst in der Schweiz. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Servicetechnikern, Werkstatt, Kunden und Lieferanten zusammen.
Was dich erwartet
· Du verantwortest den technischen Kundendienst und koordinierst die laufenden Servicefälle selbständig.
· Du wickelst Reparaturen und Reklamationen kaufmännisch ab und stellst sicher, dass offene Fälle konsequent bis zum Abschluss begleitet werden.
· Du identifizierst Ersatzteile und technische Komponenten und organisierst deren Beschaffung und Verfügbarkeit.
· Du betreust Kunden gemeinsam mit den Servicetechnikern und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Reparaturen, Ersatzteile, Reklamationen und Aftersales-Themen.
· Du klärst technische und kommerzielle Fragen direkt mit Kunden, Lieferanten und internen Ansprechpartnern.
· Du übernimmst Einkauf und Disposition für den Aftersales und behältst Termine, Aufträge und Lieferstatus zuverlässig im Blick.
· Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit Kundendienst, Verkauf und Werkstatt und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Informationsfluss.
· Du pflegst Stamm- und Auftragsdaten und stellst eine saubere Dokumentation der laufenden Vorgänge sicher.
Was du mitbringst
· Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit gutem technischem Verständnis oder eine technische Grundausbildung mit kaufmännischer bzw. betriebswirtschaftlicher Weiterbildung.
· Du verfügst über Erfahrung im Aftersales, technischen Kundendienst, Innendienst oder Reklamationswesen.
· Du kannst technische Zusammenhänge nachvollziehen und hast Freude daran, dich vertieft mit Komponenten, Ersatzteilen und technischen Lösungen auseinanderzusetzen.
· Du organisierst dich selbständig und kannst deinen Verantwortungsbereich zuverlässig strukturieren und priorisieren.
· Du behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Kundenanfragen, Reparaturen und Lieferterminen den Überblick.
· Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch. Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.
· Du trittst gegenüber Kunden verbindlich auf und findest auch bei Reklamationen einen professionellen und lösungsorientierten Umgang.
Warum du passen würdest
· Du möchtest einen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich übernehmen und den Aftersales zuverlässig und selbständig führen.
· Du kombinierst kaufmännisches Denken mit technischem Interesse und möchtest verstehen, was hinter einer Kundenanfrage steckt.
· Du arbeitest gerne eigenständig und schätzt gleichzeitig den direkten Austausch mit Servicetechnikern, Werkstatt, Verkauf und Lieferanten.
· Du bleibst an offenen Fällen dran, setzt Prioritäten und sorgst dafür, dass Kunden verlässliche Antworten erhalten.
· Du fühlst dich in einem kleinen, dynamischen Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und persönlicher Zusammenarbeit wohl.
Onboarding & Einarbeitung
Du übernimmst einen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich, wirst dabei aber sorgfältig in Produkte, Technik und interne Abläufe eingeführt. Zu Beginn lernst du die Welt der Hydraulik aus nächster Nähe kennen. Erfahrene Kollegen zeigen dir die Produkte und typischen Servicefälle, du arbeitest mit der Werkstatt zusammen und bekommst ein Gefühl dafür, was hinter einer Ersatzteilanfrage, Reparatur oder Reklamation technisch passiert.
Schon bald steuerst du deine ersten Fälle selbständig. Du klärst Kundenanfragen, identifizierst die benötigten Komponenten, koordinierst Reparaturen und Lieferungen und hältst die Beteiligten auf dem Laufenden. Mit jedem Auftrag wächst dein technisches Verständnis und du entwickelst dich zur zentralen Ansprechperson für Aftersales und Kundendienst.
Sobald du Produkte, Kunden und Abläufe sicher kennst, führst du deinen Bereich weitgehend eigenständig. Und wenn du später den nächsten Schritt suchst, ist die Perspektive bereits vorhanden: Auf Wunsch kannst du deinen Verantwortungsbereich über den Kundendienst hinaus erweitern und dich in Richtung Gesamtverantwortung für den Innendienst mit Verkaufsinnendienst und Kundendienst entwickeln.
Was dir geboten wird
· Ein eigener Verantwortungsbereich mit viel Selbständigkeit und direktem Einfluss auf die Qualität des Kundendienstes.
· Eine vielseitige Festanstellung in einem spezialisierten Schweizer KMU mit internationalem Umfeld.
· 27 Ferientage und geregelte Arbeitsbedingungen.
· Eine gezielte Einarbeitung in Produkte, Ersatzteile und technische Aftersales-Prozesse.
· Kurze Wege zu Werkstatt, Verkauf und weiteren technischen Ansprechpartnern.
· Ein offenes, dynamisches Team mit Hands-on-Mentalität und wöchentlichen gemeinsamen Mittagessen.
· Eine langfristige Entwicklungsperspektive mit der Möglichkeit, auf Wunsch später den gesamten Innendienst mit Verkaufsinnendienst und Kundendienst zu verantworten.
· Unterstützung bei fachlichen Weiterbildungen und beim Ausbau deines technischen Know-hows.

Hedepy is a mental health platform connecting people with therapists across 9 European markets. Last year we ran over 300,000 sessions, and that's just the start.
We're looking for a Czech-speaking Customer Support Specialist who does two things equally well: takes great care of clients and therapists when they reach out, and picks up the phone to reach out first. You'll be part of a close-knit Customer Care team of 7 people supporting all Hedepy markets, so the work is genuinely international even though your clients are Czech or Slovak.

Spot recurring issues and share feedback that makes our processes better.

Native Czech speaker (full fluency for complex, sensitive client conversations, or Slovak) and English at B2+ level (our internal docs, meetings and 1-on-1s run in English)

Platform & Policy Fluency: Continuously build working knowledge of PadSplit's evolving software features, Member Terms of Service, house rules, and regional occupancy/housing guidelines to provide consistent, compliant guidance.
Process Improvement & Knowledge Sharing: Actively flag recurring member pain points and contribute actionable suggestions to update help center macros, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and internal knowledge base articles.

s.h: Here’s What You’ll Need To Be Successful
s.t:
3+ Years of High-Volume Customer Care: A proven track record of 3+ years in customer service (preferably within a fast-paced contact center or remote tech support environment), with experience managing high call volumes, concurrent ticket queues, and live chats.
PropTech, Housing, or Marketplace Experience: Prior background in tech-enabled customer support, real estate, property management, co-living, or hospitality—giving you a strong baseline understanding of move-in dynamics, lease agreements, and resident care.
Customer Support Stack & CRM Proficiency: Hands-on experience navigating omnichannel support platforms (e.g., Zendesk, Intercom, Salesforce) and cloud phone systems (VoIP), paired with the ability to look up knowledge base articles and document notes while actively on calls.
Empathetic & Clear Communication: Exceptional written and verbal skills, with a talent for de-escalating tense conversations, practicing active listening, and translating complex billing or app/access troubleshooting into simple, easy-to-follow steps.
Tech Literacy & Google Workspace: Intermediate-to-advanced digital skills, including comfort with multi-tab workflows, fast typing speed, and fluency in Google Suite (Gmail, Google Sheets, Google Docs, and Google Meet).
Strict SOP Adherence & Detail Orientation: Demonstrated ability to follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), security protocols, and policy guidelines precisely—ensuring accurate account updates and protecting member privacy.
Resourceful Problem Solving: Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills to quickly diagnose root causes—such as digital key access failures, auto-pay errors, or account hold issues—and resolve them efficiently on the first contact.
Schedule Flexibility for 24/7 Operations: Willingness and capability to work flexible shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, to ensure uninterrupted coverage for members across different time zones.
High Accountability & Attendance: Exemplary attendance, punctuality, and self-discipline required to thrive in a remote or hybrid team setting where reliability directly impacts the member experience.
